url.title: EuroScope ATIS maker URL
url.subtitle: Paste this once into EuroScope; it fills the weather itself.
url.step1: In EuroScope open the Voice ATIS dialog (click the ATIS letter, top-left) and paste this URL into the 'ATIS maker URL' field.
url.step2: Type your airport ICAO into the 'ATIS airport' field and press 'Get METAR' — the macros can't resolve until an airport and METAR are loaded.
url.step3: Press 'Test URL' to see the ATIS, then connect your XXXX_ATIS position.
url.note: The $atisairportA / $arrrwy / $deprwy / $atiscodeA / $metar macros are filled by EuroScope at runtime, so this URL never changes. The macros must carry the ATIS slot letter (A–D) — unsuffixed spellings resolve to no airport and EuroScope answers 'unable to extract names from URL'. If it still says that, the ATIS airport field for that slot is empty — load it and Get METAR first. The ICAO above is only for the preview here.

atcReservations.title: ATC Reservations
atcReservations.description: Tell the network which station you plan to staff and when, so other controllers can plan around the expected coverage.
atcReservations.createHint: Announce an upcoming staffing slot. You can keep one active reservation at a time.
atcReservations.cancelConfirm: This removes the slot from the staffing board. The controller is not notified.
atcReservations.errorAlreadyReserved: You already have an active reservation.
atcReservations.errorCallsign: That callsign is not valid — use 3–16 characters, letters, digits, _ or -.
atcReservations.errorWindow: That window is not valid. It must end in the future, run no longer than {hours} hours, and start within the next {days} days.
atcReservations.errorTooMany: Too many reservation changes. Try again later.
atcReservations.formCallsignHint: The station you will staff, e.g. ZBAA_TWR.
atcReservations.formEndsAtHint: At most {hours} hours after the start time.
atcReservations.endBeforeStart: End time must be after start time.
atcReservations.errorDescriptionTooLong: That note is too long — {chars} characters at most.
